name: Swinub
description: Swinub excels at sniffing out mushrooms buried beneath grass or snow. Since ancient times, the people of Hisui have often relied upon this skill.

moves.name: Fuerza Equina

moves.name: Poder Pasado
moves.description: Ataque prehistórico que puede subir todas las  características.

moves.name: Doble Filo
